title: Sample preparation of label-free GAG disaccharides from biological tissues
author: H Davies-Strickleton
materials: 5 M Ammonium Acetate Stock, pH 7 Prepare around 50 mL, based on the following example: Weigh ~ 19.25 g Ammonium acetate VWR International (Avantor) Catalog #84885.180 Add the required volume of ddH 2 O using the formula below (for 19.25 g, add 50 mL ddH 2 O) Adjust to pH 7 by addition of a small volume of Ammonia solution 25% for HPL Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #5438300100 Exact weights and volumes can be adjusted using the formula below. Weigh approximately 19.25 g ammonium acetate, then use the formula below to calculate the volume of ddH 2 O to add (V) V = m / (C*MW) where: V = desired volume (L) m = mass of solute (g) C = desired concentration (M; mol/L) = 5 MW = molecular weight (g/mol) = 77.08 Example If 20 g ammonium acetate was weighed then the volume required would be: 20/(5*77.08) = 0.05189 L or 51.89 mL

300 mM Calcium Chloride Stock Prepare around 50 mL, based on the following example: Dissolve 1.665 g Calcium chloride Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #102391 (CAS: 10043-52-4) in 50 mL ddH 2 O Exact weights and volumes can be adjusted using the formula below. Weigh approximately 1.665 g CaCl 2 , then use the formula below to calculate the volume of ddH 2 O to add (V) V = m / (C*MW) where: V = desired volume (L) m = mass of solute (g) C = desired concentration (M) = 0.3 MW = molecular weight = 110.98 Example If 2g CaCl 2 was weighed then the volume required would be: 2/(0.3*110.98) = 0.0600 L or 60 mL

Pre-wash 500 μL 3 kDa MWCO filters with 200 µL ddH 2 O by centrifugation at 14000 x g, °C, for 10 minutes (discard flow through) Amicon Ultra-0.5 Centrifugal Filter Unit (Centrifugal Filter Unit, Millipore, UFC5003BK, https://www.merckmillipore.com/GB/en/product/Amicon-Ultra-0.5-Centrifugal-Filter-Unit,MM_NF-UFC5003BK )

Thaw the amount of Chondrotinase ABC (ChABC) enzyme required for all samples Chondroitinase ABC from Proteus vulgaris Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #C2905-10UN (CAS: 9024-13-9) ChABC is stored at -80oC in 10 μL aliquots at 10 mU/μL in 50 mM sodium acetate pH 7. Only thaw the volume you need. Each sample requires 1 μL of ChABC at 10 mU/μL (before dilution). Therefore for 12 samples, thaw 12 μL of 10 mU/μL ChABC.
Assign a well to each sample

Weigh the required amount of Pronase, and prepare Pronase Stock: For example, for 50 samples prepare 12 mL 1 mg/mL Pronase Stock (see above for calculations): Weigh 12 mg Pronase Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #10165921001 Add 12 mL Pronase Buffer go to step #10 Mix well Exact weights and volumes can be adjusted using the formula below. Weigh approximately 12 mg Pronase, then use the formula below to calculate the volume of Pronase Buffer to add (V) V = m / C where: V = volume (mL) m = mass of solute (mg) C = concentration (mg/mL) = 1 Example If 14 mg Pronase was weighed then the volume required would be: 14/1 = 14 mL

Weigh the required amount of DNase I, and prepare DNase I Stock: For example for 50 samples prepare 1.2 mL 4 mg/mL DNase I Stock: Weigh 4.8 mg DNAse I Roche Catalog #10104159001 Add 1.2 mL 5 μM Magnesium Chloride Solution go to step #7 Mix well Exact weights and volumes can be adjusted using the formula below. Weigh approximately 5 mg DNase I, then use the formula below to calculate the volume of 5 μM Magnesium Chloride Solution to add (V) V = m / C where: V = volume (mL) m = mass of solute (mg) C = concentration (mg/mL) = 4 Example If 6 mg DNase I was weighed then the volume required would be: 6/4= 1.5 mL

steps.title: Prepare Stock Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the following stock solutions and store at 4 °C as indicated.

substeps.instruction: 5 mM Magnesium Chloride: Dissolve 50.8 mg MgCl2 (Fischer Scientific #10647032) in 50 mL ddH2O (or use V = m / (C*MW) where C=0.005, MW=203.3). Store up to 1 year.
100 μM Calcium Chloride: Dilute 300 mM Calcium Chloride Stock 1 in 3000 (e.g., 5 µL stock in 15 mL ddH2O). Store for 6 months.
5 μM Magnesium Chloride: Dilute 5 mM Magnesium Chloride Stock 1 in 1000 (e.g., 10 µL stock in 9.990 mL ddH2O). Store for 3 months.
10x Heparinase Buffer: Mix 41 mL ddH2O, 4000 µL 5 M Ammonium Acetate Stock, and 5000 µL 300 mM Calcium Chloride Stock. Adjust to pH 7. Store for 6 months.
10x Chondroitinase Buffer: Mix 46 mL ddH2O, 4000 µL 5 M Ammonium Acetate Stock, and 5 µL 300 mM Calcium Chloride Stock. Adjust to pH 7. Store for 6 months.
Pronase Buffer: Mix 21.36 mL ddH2O, 2.4 mL 500 mM Ammonium Acetate Stock (pH 7), and 240 µL 100 μM Calcium Chloride Solution. Store for 1 month.
500 mM Ammonium Acetate Solution (pH 7): Dilute 5 M Ammonium Acetate 1 in 10 (e.g., 5 mL stock in 45 mL ddH2O). Adjust to pH 7. Store for 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare Samples and Controls
steps.instruction: Place disrupted biological material (Test Samples) and a Positive Control Sample (e.g., lung tissue homogenate) into labeled 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Prepare fresh 1 mg/mL Pronase Stock in a fume hood. Calculate volume as V = 1.2 * (0.2 mL * number of samples).
Add 200 µL of 1 mg/mL Pronase Stock to each sample and mix briefly.
Incubate at 37 °C overnight.
Vortex samples and continue incubation for 1 hour.
Heat deactivate at 98 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: DNase I Digestion
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from samples using DNase I.

substeps.instruction: Prepare fresh 4 mg/mL DNase I Stock in a fume hood. Calculate volume as V = 1.2 * (0.02 mL * number of samples).
Add 20 µL of 4 mg/mL DNase I stock to each sample.
Vortex briefly.
Incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour (samples may be frozen here if needed).

steps.title: GAG Enrichment via MWCO Filtration
steps.instruction: Concentrate GAGs using Molecular Weight Cut-Off (MWCO) filters.

substeps.instruction: Load sample supernatants into pre-washed MWCO filters.
Centrifuge at 14,000 x g at ambient temperature for 25 minutes (or until retentate is 50-100 µL); discard flow-through.
Wash retentate with 400 µL ddH2O by centrifuging at 14,000 x g for 25 minutes (or until 50-100 µL remains); discard flow-through.
Repeat wash/spin until retentate volume is 20-50 µL.
Invert MWCO filter into a fresh tube and centrifuge at 1,000 x g for 2 minutes to collect sample.
Pipette up/down and transfer samples to labeled 1.5 mL protein lo-bind tubes.

steps.title: Sample Aliquoting (Optional)
steps.instruction: If analyzing both HS and CS/DS/HA, divide the sample into two aliquots (e.g., equal volumes).

steps.title: Heparan Sulfate (HS) Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform this section only for samples requiring HS disaccharide analysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL 10x Heparinase Buffer to GAG enriched samples.
Prepare Heparinase Enzyme Mix: Thaw and combine equal volumes (1 μL per sample) of Bacteroides Heparinase I (#P0735L), II (#P0736L), and III (#P0737L).
Add 3 µL Heparinase Enzyme Mix to each sample.
Mix by pipetting or vortexing and spin briefly.
Incubate at 30 °C overnight with mixing at 2000 rpm.

steps.title: CS/DS/HA Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform this section only for samples requiring CS/DS/HA disaccharide analysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL 10x Chondroitinase Buffer to GAG enriched samples.
If multiple aliquots exist, combine into one tube.
Dilute ChABC to 2.5 mU/μL by adding 3 parts ddH2O to 1 part 10 mU/μL ChABC (e.g., 12 µL enzyme + 36 µL ddH2O).
Add 4 µL of 2.5 mU/μL ChABC (10 mU total) to each sample.
Mix by pipetting or vortexing and spin briefly.
Incubate at 37 °C overnight with mixing at 2000 rpm.

steps.title: Internal Standard Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the internal standard solution for spiking.

substeps.instruction: Thaw 1 mg/mL Internal Standard Stock (∆UA-2S GlcNCOEt-6S (I-P), Iduron #HD009).
Dilute 1:100 to make 10 μg/mL solution (e.g., 10 µL stock + 990 µL ddH2O).
Dilute 1:10 to make 1 μg/mL solution (e.g., 100 µL of 10 μg/mL solution + 900 µL ddH2O). Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Sample Clean-up and IS Spiking
steps.instruction: Use Solid Phase Extraction (SPE) to remove contaminants and spike with Internal Standard (IS).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge all samples after GAG digestion at 15,000 rpm for 15 minutes at 4 °C.
Pre-wash Oasis HLB 96-well µElution Plate wells with 100 µL ddH2O; centrifuge to waste at 1,000 rpm for 2 minutes.
Load sample supernatant into HLB plate wells.
Add 8 µL of 1 μg/mL Internal Standard Solution to each well using a multichannel pipette.
Mix by pipetting up/down several times.
Centrifuge at 100-500 x g for 3 minutes. Repeat spins at 500-2000 x g for 3-5 minutes until all volume has passed through.
Add 50 µL ddH2O to wells and centrifuge at 100-2000 x g until wells are dry to collect flow-through.
Transfer collected flow-through to labeled 2 mL safelock tubes with pierced lids.
Freeze samples at -80 °C or on dry ice briefly.
Freeze-dry (lyophilize) the samples.
Cap with unpierced lids and store at 4 °C for HILIC-MS/MS analysis.
